# Albumen

> Open-source, bring-your-own-storage, MCP-native photo library. Originals are bit-exact, metadata is never lost, and a full export is one command.

Reliability, fidelity, respect, and control are the metrics. Cost is outside those metrics. The commitment is the design philosophy. The working guide for agents is AGENTS.md.

## Docs

- [Design philosophy](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/DESIGN_PHILOSOPHY.md): Bit-exact originals, checksums on the CI gate, never delete, one-step export, bring-your-own storage, respect for the user, and the MCP cap.
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Build and test commands, the round-trip gate, never-delete rules, and where to start.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Philosophy acknowledgment, Developer Certificate of Origin, and how agents contribute.
- [README](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/README.md): What the repository does today.
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/ROADMAP.md): Work that is not in the tree yet.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Ingest, export, the camera receiver, and the MCP server.
- [MCP registry draft](https://github.com/jay-the-maker/albumen/blob/main/docs/mcp-registry.md): `server.json` metadata for the official MCP Registry. Not submitted.
